Job Description:
At a glance

Want to work on technology where speed, reliability and quality really matter? Join our FX Engineering team and work on the technology behind our Foreign Exchange trading business. This is a senior engineering role with real impact: the systems you help improve are used every day by our trading and sales teams.

As Software Quality Lead, you get the freedom to shape how we approach quality across our FX technology landscape. You will work with engineers, traders and product managers to make our systems easier to test, safer to change and more reliable in productionThis is not a traditional testing role where you simply validate software at the end of the development process. We want to build quality into engineering from the start.

You will help us improve test automation, end-to-end testing, CI/CD and release practices. And because our platform combines our own technology with integrations and SaaS solutions, there are plenty of interesting engineering challenges to solve. You don't have to do this alone. You will work with experienced engineers and business specialists, while having the opportunity to introduce your own ideas, tools and ways of working.

In short: a senior role for someone who enjoys technology, likes solving complex problems and wants the freedom to make things better.

Your job

Your goal is simple: help us deliver changes faster and with confidence.

You will take the lead on quality engineering across our FX platform, while staying close enough to the technology to understand what really happens in production.

You will:

Shape and improve our approach to quality engineering and testing.
Work directly with engineers, traders and product managers on new functionality.
Turn business requirements into clear acceptance criteria and smart test scenarios.
Own end-to-end testing across applications, integrations and SaaS platforms.
Identify edge cases and risks before they become production issues.
Increase test automation using tools such as Playwright, Selenium or similar frameworks.
Bring automated testing and quality controls further into our CI/CD pipelines.
Improve regression testing and release confidence.
Help assess the impact of vendor and platform changes on our trading environment.
Be involved in production and incident management as part of our DevOps way of working.
Share your experience with other engineers and help the team develop its quality engineering capabilities.


Most importantly, you will have room to challenge how we work today. If something can be automated, simplified or done better, we want you to tell us and help us change it.

Why this role is interesting

For an experienced engineer, this role offers an unusual combination.

Complex technology You are working in a connected landscape of trading applications, integrations, APIs and third-party platforms. Small changes can have an impact across an entire trading flow, which makes engineering quality genuinely interesting.
Close to the business You won't be several layers removed from the people using your technology. You will work directly with traders, sales colleagues and product managers and see how your work improves their day-to-day processes.
Real engineering influence We are actively improving our engineering and quality practices. That means you are not joining an environment where everything has already been decided. You can influence our choices around automation, testing, CI/CD and releases.
Senior-level ownership We are looking for someone who sees a problem and wants to solve it. You will have the space to bring your experience, challenge existing approaches and help set the direction.
A modern DevOps mindset Quality is not the responsibility of one test team at the end of a project. It is part of engineering. Development, testing, deployment and production reliability belong together.


Working environment

You will join a technology-focused environment where engineers work closely with the FX trading business. We combine the pace and technical challenges of Financial Markets with the scale and opportunities of a large organisation. The role is hybrid, with three days per week in the office in Amstelveen. This is especially valuable in this team because you'll regularly collaborate directly with engineers, traders and other colleagues involved in the trading platform.

Your profile

We are primarily looking for an experienced engineer with a strong quality mindset. You don't need to tick every box. If you have worked in a complex engineering environment and recognise yourself in most of the description below, we would like to hear from you.

You probably bring experience in several of these areas:

Quality Engineering, Test Automation, Software Engineering or a similar senior technical role.
Building or improving automated testing frameworks.
End-to-end, integration, functional and regression testing.
Tools such as Playwright, Selenium or comparable technologies.
CI/CD, DevOps and modern software delivery practices.
Working with distributed systems, integrations, APIs or SaaS platforms.
Production support, incident management and release processes.
Working directly with business stakeholders to understand what software actually needs to do.


Experience in Financial Markets, trading technology or another complex financial environment is a strong advantage. Knowledge of FX, pricing, risk management, trade execution or post-trade processes is great to have, but we are also interested in senior engineers who bring relevant experience from other complex technology environments.

We are offering

We believe it is important to be a good employer. Joining us means stepping into a role with impact, supported by excellent employment conditions that foster your job satisfaction, development, and wellbeing.

In addition, we offer:

An attractive gross monthly salary based on a 36-hour work week, including holiday allowanceand a flexible benefit budget.
An excellent pension scheme, ensuring that you are well prepared for the future.
Flexibility in working: working from home is possible in consultation with your team and depending on your role. We will provide an ergonomic home office setup for you.
Plenty of room for relaxation with five weeks of vacation per year, supplemented by two mandatory days off. You can also purchase up to four additional weeks of vacation annually.

Personal development is key: you receive a development budget of €1,000 per year, which can accumulate up to €3,000.
An annual public transport pass with free public transportation throughout the Netherlands for both business and private use.

Job Description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Data QA Engineer based in Netherlands.

As a Data QA Engineer, you will play a key role in ensuring the accuracy, reliability, and quality of data delivered to customers across a range of web scraping and AI-assisted projects. You will take ownership of quality assurance from the early stages of project development, translating customer requirements into clear and effective testing strategies. Combining exploratory testing, automated validation, and data analysis, you will identify inconsistencies, detect defects, and help prevent quality issues before they reach production. You will work closely with developers, project managers, QA leadership, and customers to establish measurable quality standards and continuously improve testing practices. Using Python, SQL, and modern testing technologies, you will turn complex data into actionable quality insights. Joining a globally distributed and collaborative team, you will enjoy the autonomy to improve processes and contribute to innovative data solutions.

Accountabilities

Translate customer data extraction and web scraping requirements into clear, measurable testing strategies, taking ownership of quality assurance from the beginning of new projects. 
Design and execute comprehensive test plans combining exploratory, manual, visual, and automated testing approaches according to project needs. 
Perform regular testing cycles on extracted datasets to validate data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and reliability. 
Identify, investigate, document, and report defects with clear reproduction steps and sufficient technical detail to enable developers to resolve issues efficiently. 
Apply descriptive statistics, data summaries, and visualizations to assess data quality, identify anomalies, and monitor potential data drift. 
Prepare detailed test reports and quality scores, providing internal stakeholders and customers with an accurate understanding of project quality and potential risks. 
Clearly communicate testing coverage, limitations, unresolved issues, and remaining risks throughout the delivery process. 
Collaborate with project managers and customers to clarify requirements, identify ambiguities, and ensure that expectations are measurable and testable before QA activities begin. 
Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of test automation frameworks, focusing on test coverage, reliability, and performance. 
Identify and implement improvements to QA processes and tools, including browser extensions, spreadsheet add-ons, and user-interface-based testing solutions. 
Work closely with QA leadership, developers, and project managers to maintain high-quality standards while operating with a high degree of independence. 

Requirements

At least 5 years of professional experience as a QA Engineer or in a comparable quality assurance role, preferably involving software testing, data validation, or data quality. 
Strong Python programming skills, ideally with practical experience using Pandas and Jupyter Notebook for data analysis, processing, and validation. 
Basic to intermediate SQL knowledge, with the ability to write queries and work confidently with at least one relational database and its associated tools. 
Solid understanding of web technologies and protocols, including HTML, XPath, JSON, HTTP, and CSS. 
Practical experience designing and executing tests for HTTP and REST APIs. 
Strong knowledge of test case design, test planning, test execution, and test data management. 
Understanding of key data quality concepts, including completeness, accuracy, consistency, reliability, and data drift. 
Experience working in Agile development environments, including Scrum or Kanban, and collaborating closely with software developers. 
Familiarity with AI and Large Language Model (LLM) tools, particularly their application in generating test cases, accelerating data validation, and improving QA workflows. 
Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities, combined with strong attention to detail and a proactive approach to quality ownership. 
Ability to quickly understand complex project requirements, learn new technologies, and adapt to changing priorities. 
Confidence in maintaining high-quality standards and raising concerns when delivery timelines or project pressures could compromise quality. 
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. 

Nice To Have

Working knowledge of Scrapy and other Python-based web scraping frameworks. 
Previous experience developing or working with test automation frameworks. 
Interest or experience in data science concepts, particularly as applied to data analysis, interpretation, and validation. 
Enthusiasm for exploring AI and LLM-powered tools to improve testing efficiency and accelerate data quality assessments. 

Benefits

Fully Remote Work: Enjoy the freedom and flexibility to work from anywhere in the world, choosing the environment where you are most productive. 
Generous Paid Leave: Benefit from 35 days of paid holidays per year, supporting a healthy work-life balance. 
International Team: Become part of a self-motivated, progressive, and multicultural team of more than 250 professionals distributed across over 28 countries. 
Innovative Technologies: Work with cutting-edge open-source technologies, modern tools, and innovative data extraction solutions. 
Flexible Working Environment: Enjoy the autonomy and flexibility to organize your work in a way that supports productivity and personal wellbeing. 
Professional Growth: Develop your technical expertise by working on challenging data quality projects alongside experienced professionals in a collaborative environment.

Word de beste versie van jezelf als Test Automation Engineer

Bij Sogeti krijg je de ruimte én het vertrouwen om de beste versie van jezelf te worden. Als Test Automation Engineer maak je deel uit van de grootste Test Automation community van Nederland: een netwerk van gedreven vakgenoten die elkaar versterken, uitdagen en samen innoveren. Binnen deze community draait het om vooruitgang. Je kunt deelnemen aan inspiratiesessies en kennisdelingsmomenten, hier doe je niet alleen nieuwe ideeën op, maar krijg je ook het podium om jouw expertise en visie te delen.

Heb je ervaring met AI en/of het testen van AI-Tooling? Zie je jezelf als AI test automation specialist van de toekomst? Misschien wil je juist investeren in je communicatieve of leiderschapsvaardigheden om meer impact te maken binnen teams en organisaties. Wat jouw ambitie ook is, met onze uitgebreide inhouse trainingen krijg je alle kansen om gericht aan je ontwikkeling te werken. Zo bouw je niet alleen aan slimme oplossingen voor klanten, maar ook aan een carrière waar je trots op kunt zijn.

Wonen en werken in Noordoost Nederland met standplaats Zwolle

Uiteraard begrijpen we hoe belangrijk het is om te werken in de regio waar je woont, en daar zetten wij ons voor in. Professionals in Noordoost Nederland werken vanuit onze regiovestiging in Groningen. Dankzij werken op afstand en slim klantbeheer minimaliseren we je reistijd. Deze vestiging biedt alle disciplines onder een dak, waardoor je als test engineer makkelijk kunt sparren met collega's en projectmatig kunt werken. Onze opdrachtgevers komen uit diverse sectoren, wat zorgt voor afwisselende projecten. Als voorstander van hybride werken stimuleren we bovendien gedeeltelijk thuiswerken. Een echte Sogetist is een vakexpert met passie en plezier! We staan altijd voor elkaar klaar, en dat leidt tot de mooiste resultaten!

Waarom jij het verschil maakt

Bij onze klanten maak jij als Test Automation Engineer impact door het verbeteren van bestaande test automation of het implementeren van nieuwe test automation. Je kan de klant uitstekend adviseren over het duurzaam maken van test automation en het implementeren van goede techniek en feedback loop, omdat je weet wat er nodig is voor future proof test automation en wat de waarde is van de feedback loop. Jouw technische vaardigheden zorgen ervoor dat je dit zelf kan inbouwen, maar je kan ook anderen hierbij helpen. Job Description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) based in Netherlands.

As an SDET, you will play a critical role in ensuring the quality, accuracy and reliability of a sophisticated customer data ecosystem. You will design, develop and maintain automated testing frameworks that validate complex data pipelines, integrations and digital customer experiences. Working across modern technologies such as Databricks, mParticle, Braze, OneTrust and ThoughtSpot, you will help protect data integrity and ensure seamless information flows across platforms. You will collaborate closely with Data Engineers and other technical teams to identify defects, investigate anomalies and prevent recurring issues. This is a hands-on engineering position focused on building scalable automation solutions rather than relying on manual testing. You will join a fast-growing, international and remote-first environment that encourages ownership, innovation and continuous professional development.

Accountabilities

Design and implement automated data validation frameworks to test data contracts, schema compliance and identity resolution processes within Databricks before information reaches downstream activation platforms.
Develop and maintain automated UI and behavioural testing scripts that simulate real-world customer journeys across web and mobile applications.
Programmatically validate behavioural events, mParticle tags and OneTrust consent tokens to ensure accurate event tracking and application-level data collection.
Test and monitor critical data flows across the Databricks, mParticle, Braze and OneTrust ecosystem, ensuring consistency and reliability between platforms.
Develop automated integration tests and mock API payloads to verify that actions, user data and audience updates are correctly transferred across systems.
Design and execute end-to-end testing for data collection pipelines, including POS, web, mobile applications and CRM systems, ensuring data is accurately cleaned, standardised and transformed.
Validate data freshness, processing accuracy and latency against near-real-time service-level agreements (SLAs).
Establish and maintain automated data quality and hygiene checks to detect corrupted records, inconsistencies and schema drift in near real time.
Audit data flows and consent management processes to ensure privacy preferences are consistently respected across systems and comply with applicable regulations, including GDPR and UK GDPR.
Investigate and troubleshoot data anomalies, identify root causes and collaborate with Data Engineers to resolve pipeline failures efficiently.
Take ownership of defects throughout their lifecycle, implementing regression tests and preventative measures to avoid recurring issues.
Contribute to improving testing strategies, automation architecture and quality assurance practices across the wider data ecosystem.

Advanced SQL skills, including the ability to write complex validation queries and scripts to identify anomalies across millions of records.
Strong proficiency in Python for developing automated test suites, building testing frameworks and interacting with APIs.
Proven experience designing and implementing data test automation frameworks from scratch.
Hands-on experience testing within Databricks or an equivalent cloud data warehouse or lakehouse environment.
Strong understanding of Delta Lake or similar data architectures.
Experience validating complex data transformations across batch and near-real-time or streaming pipelines.
Familiarity with data orchestration and transformation tools such as Apache Airflow and dbt.
Experience testing data flows through Customer Data Platforms (CDPs), particularly mParticle, including event ingestion, identity resolution and audience synchronisation with downstream engagement platforms.
Proven ability to investigate data anomalies, troubleshoot pipeline failures and collaborate with Data Engineers to resolve issues and prevent regressions.
Experience testing REST APIs and validating data payloads exchanged between systems and platforms.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and take ownership of technical challenges.

Nice to have: Experience testing integrations between Customer Data Platforms and engagement platforms, including mParticle audience synchronisation and event forwarding into Braze.
Nice to have: Knowledge of privacy compliance and consent management frameworks, particularly through tools such as OneTrust.
Nice to have: Experience integrating automated data quality checks into CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitHub Actions or GitLab CI.
A proactive and detail-oriented mindset, with a strong interest in building reliable, scalable and maintainable automated testing solutions.

Wil jij dat fundament onderhouden en verder verstevigen? Ben jij een ervaren delivery manager die mensen weet te inspireren, energie brengt en concrete resultaten realiseert, ook wanneer het werk minder in de schijnwerpers staat dan de nieuwste feature? En zie jij hoe AI kan helpen om slimmer, sneller en voorspelbaarder te werken? Dan is deze rol iets voor jou.

Wat ga je doen?
Als Delivery Manager Business Hub geef je leiding aan de teams die verantwoordelijk zijn voor de stabiliteit, continuïteit en kwaliteit van onze belangrijkste platformen en ketens. Dit zijn de omgevingen die ervoor zorgen dat klanten kunnen vergelijken, afsluiten, wijzigen en beheren — elke dag opnieuw.
Jouw opdracht is helder: het fundament sterk en betrouwbaar houden, prioriteiten scherpstellen en teams voorspelbaar laten leveren op wat er echt toe doet. Je bewaakt de balans tussen continuïteit, klantwaarde, technische kwaliteit, security, compliance en businessimpact. Je bent zichtbaar, betrokken en hands-on. Je helpt teams keuzes te maken, haalt blokkades weg en pakt door wanneer dat nodig is. Je weet mensen te enthousiasmeren en te inspireren, en je maakt van precisie en betrouwbaarheid iets om trots op te zijn, juist in een omgeving waar de druk soms hoog is en de belangen groot zijn. Tegelijkertijd kijk je vooruit. Je begrijpt de toegevoegde waarde van AI en vertaalt kansen naar praktische toepassingen die leiden tot betere support, efficiëntere processen, snellere analyse en meer voorspelbaarheid.
Je rapporteert aan de Head of Tech en werkt nauw samen met andere Delivery Managers, Product Owners, Tech Leads en stakeholders binnen Tech, Data en Business.

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden
Van de Business Hub een plek maken waar betrouwbaarheid, vakmanschap en samenwerking net zo sterk worden gewaardeerd als innovatie en nieuwbouw.
Zorgen voor stabiele, betrouwbare en toekomstbestendige omzetkritische platformen, met focus op continuïteit, kwaliteit en beheersbare operatie.
Leidinggeven aan en ontwikkelen van multidisciplinaire techteams, met aandacht voor eigenaarschap, groei en teamperformance.
Prioriteren van onderhoud, incidenten, risico’s en verbeteringen, en sturen op structurele oplossingen in plaats van ad-hoc brandjes.
Bewaken welk werk wel en niet bij de Business Hub thuishoort, zodat teams focus houden en ruimte hebben om te excelleren.
Verbinden van tech en business bij keuzes met impact op klant, omzet, risico, kwaliteit en continuïteit.
Sturen op resultaten, capaciteit, budget en voorspelbare delivery.
Borgen van kennis en zorgen voor een sterke overdracht van change naar run, inclusief duidelijke afspraken over readiness, support en eigenaarschap.
Zorgen dat security, privacy en DORA-compliance praktisch worden meegenomen in dagelijkse keuzes rondom run, change, incidenten en leveranciersafspraken.
Sturen op beheersing van operationele risico’s, waaronder toegangsbeheer, kwetsbaarheden, logging, monitoring en herstelbaarheid.
AI-kansen vertalen naar concrete verbeteringen in processen, support en delivery.

Salaris tot maximaal €8.500,- bruto o.b.v. 40 uur, vakantiegeld en een jaarlijkse bonus;
30 vakantiedagen en een premievrij pensioen;
Reiskostenvergoeding en een thuiswerk- en internetvergoeding;
De mogelijkheid om voor 50% vanuit huis te werken;
In de winter in de zon werken? Ga een aantal weken op workation;
Veel ruimte om te groeien en ontwikkelen d.m.v. ons brede opleidingsaanbod;
Leuke events, borrels en sportactiviteiten;
Dagelijks een uitgebreide en gezonde lunch;
Een fijn kantoor met gratis parkeergelegenheid en station Hilversum op loopafstand;
En natuurlijk een bedrijf vol enthousiaste collega’s!

Wat zoeken wij in jou?
Jij begrijpt dat continuïteit geen passieve beheerrol is, maar een actieve verantwoordelijkheid voor klantwaarde, omzet en vertrouwen. Je bent een stevige, energieke delivery manager die rust en structuur brengt, en tegelijkertijd ook energie en beweging.
Je bent praktisch ingesteld, resultaatgericht en schakelt makkelijk tussen tactische keuzes en operationele realiteit. Je hoeft niet alles zelf te bouwen, maar hebt voldoende technische bagage om de juiste vragen te stellen en samen met teams tot goede keuzes te komen.
Daarnaast breng je mee:
Academisch werk- en denkniveau.
Ervaring met het leiden en ontwikkelen van technische teams.
Ervaring met delivery, beheer, onderhoud of operatie-kritische IT-omgevingen.
Sterk vermogen om te prioriteren op klantimpact, omzetimpact, risico en capaciteit.
Ervaring met agile, lean of kanban-achtige werkwijzen.
Sterk stakeholdermanagement en duidelijke communicatie richting tech en business.
Basiskennis van security, risicomanagement en relevante compliancekaders zoals DORA, NIS2 of ISO 27001, met de nadruk op praktische toepassing.
Ervaring met het vertalen van compliance-eisen naar werkbare teamafspraken, concrete acties en duidelijke rapportages.
Technische achtergrond of voldoende technische diepgang.
Affiniteit met AI en het vermogen om dit praktisch toepasbaar te maken.
Hands-on mentaliteit en een sterke can-do houding.
Inspirerend leiderschap en oog voor teamontwikkeling.

Independer is één van de grootste online platformen van Nederland en helpt miljoenen mensen bij het maken van betere keuzes rondom hun vaste lasten. Je werkt in een omgeving met veel verantwoordelijkheid, korte lijnen en zichtbare impact. We zijn ambitieus, ondernemend en continu in beweging. Je krijgt de ruimte om te bouwen aan een nieuwe manier van werken waarin continuïteit, waardecreatie, samenwerking en innovatie elkaar versterken. Onze strategie is om de vaste lasten bewaker te worden van Nederland voor de consument en daar zijn we elke dag hard voor aan het werk.

About the Foundation
The Access to Medicine Foundation is an independent non-profit organisation, based in Amsterdam, that seeks to transform the global healthcare ecosystem by motivating and mobilising companies to expand access to their essential healthcare products in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs). The core pillar of our work is analysing how pharmaceutical companies, and other essential healthcare companies currently address the affordability and accessibility of their products in these countries, and highlighting gaps, best practices and opportunities. To translate our research into real-world change, we engage with a wide network of global health stakeholders, including pharmaceutical companies, governments, international agencies such as the United Nations and World Health Organization, media, and investors.

Operations at the Foundation
You will be joining our Operations, Data Management and IT (ODMIT) team, reporting to the Chief Operating Officer. Our workstyle is highly collaborative, yet with clear ownership of different streams and projects. We work closely with colleagues at all levels of the organisation, including the CEO and members of the engagement and research teams. The ODMIT team plays a central role within the Foundation in providing optimal circumstances for other teams to work in, enabling cross-functional collaboration and ensuring data integrity.

Your main tasks and responsibilities
• Develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for a variety of data management activities (transfer of data, confidentiality of data, storage, archival, access, processing of data) and disseminate within the organization.
• Ensure data practices comply with rules and regulations including GDPR, information security, Non-Disclosure Agreements (with collaborating companies) and ethical requirements, and contribute to the implementation of data governance frameworks and relevant standards (e.g. ISO 27001).

• Evaluate and improve the use of data management applications (including CRM, project management and research data bases) and develop and maintain “Best Practice” guidelines for data standardisation and harmonisation.
• Provide (consultative) data management advice to research teams and other teams as required (i.e. data structure, data collection options, scoring frameworks).
• Train Foundation employees on data management platforms and related tools.

Analytical thinking skills: You can analyse complex situations and workflows, see how they connect across the organisation, and design practical improvements.
Ownership and people skills: You take responsibility for following up on processes and have the skills to bring colleagues along with changes.
Affinity with applications: Knowledge of AirTable, Wrike, Copper and Microsoft Excel, or similar systems, is a plus.
Independence and accuracy: You work independently and in a structured way, with a strong emphasis on accuracy and precision.
Agile and proactive: able to work to multiple deadlines and flag potential roadblocks and/or bottlenecks before they become urgent.
Training and capacity building: You enjoy explaining technical concepts in an accessible way and have experience designing or delivering trainings to improve data literacy.
Communication skills: You are able to communicate effectively with various stakeholders and can express yourself fluently in English.

• Data management or analytics qualification is a plus (experience with platforms such as Airtable, Microsoft 365 administration, Google Workspaces administration..).
• A logical, structured way of thinking; experience with programming, scripting or automation tools is a plus
• Experience with data governance or information security frameworks.
• Practical experience using AI tools in a work setting, with an understanding of ethical and responsible data and AI use.Project management experience is a plus.
• Highly proficient in English.
• Knowledge of GDPR and experience with DPIA is a plus.
• Experience with data collection processes is a plus.

The position will be based in Amsterdam and a valid work permit to work in the Netherlands is required.

What we offer you

• Hybrid options available: 2-3 days per week in our office in Amsterdam, with the option to work from your home in the Netherlands on the remaining days. (This position is not available for remote working in a country outside the Netherlands – there will be no compensation for relocation costs).

Job Description:
Product & Delivery Lead

Groenlo, Netherlands

32 - 38 hrs

€ 5.000 - € 7.000

Hybrid

What are you going to do?

At Nedap in Security, we help organizations around the world manage physical access securely and reliably. Our technology ensures that the right people have access to the right places and gives organizations control over their security.

We are building a new technology platform for our future security solutions. The first major challenge is to develop a new access control proposition that enables existing customers to move from AEOS to a new platform while retaining the continuity and confidence they rely on.

As Product & Delivery Lead, you are responsible for the product direction and coordinated delivery of the next technology platform across teams and workstreams. You translate portfolio priorities into a clear product plan and work closely with the teams to turn those plans into working results. The challenge is to balance customer needs, technical development and delivery while building a way of working that grows with this new technology platform

Initially, you will be closely involved in day-to-day product development and delivery. As more teams and workstreams are added, your focus is expected to shift increasingly toward the bigger picture: maintaining direction and alignment across the program while others take ownership of individual areas. How this develops will depend on what the program needs.

Start your application 

Your responsibilities

This technology platform is at the beginning of an ambitious development journey. The teams are growing, the platform is taking shape, and not everything has been decided yet. You bring focus and help us move forward while helping to organize product development effectively. You:

You translate portfolio priorities into clear product goals and a roadmap, balancing customer value, technical needs and available capacity.

You agree on achievable milestones and clear outcomes with the teams and help them deliver working solutions.

You keep an overview of priorities and dependencies across teams and workstreams, discuss risks and adjust course when needed.

You work with customers and colleagues across product, engineering and the AEGIS program to make well-informed decisions.

You help shape how product responsibility and delivery are organized as this grows, so that responsibilities can be shared effectively.

Your team

Within this new technology platform, colleagues from across Nedap in Security work together to build the foundation for our next generation of security solutions. We are starting with a small number of dedicated teams and expect to grow further over the coming year.

You work closely with engineers, technical leads, the Team Lead Engineering, Program Manager, AI Enablement Coach/Engineer and colleagues from the wider program. Together, you discover what works, make decisions and develop the collaboration needed to move forward. You also participate in the program’s product management team, where product, commercial and program perspectives come together.

As this grows, Product Owners or Workstream Leads may join to take responsibility for specific areas. Their responsibilities and the way you will work together are still taking shape. You have the opportunity to help build an organization that fits the challenge ahead.

Our offer

What's in it for you?

We have the ambition and the opportunity to shape the future. And we need people with the drive to turn that into meaningful impact. You get the chance to contribute to something truly unique, alongside more than 1,000 driven and like-minded colleagues.

From day one, you help us fulfill our purpose: Technology for Life. The way you grow, take initiative, and deliver impact helps bring that purpose to life. We shape what’s next. Together.

Compensation. Matching your knowledge and experience. The range for this role is € 5000 - € 7000 gross per month based on full-time employment (38 hours). 
Financial benefits. A 13th month, a solid pension plan, profit sharing, and the opportunity to become a Nedap shareholder. 
Space and trust. You coordinate your own working hours and vacation days in consultation with your colleagues to achieve a healthy work-life balance. 
Professional challenge. Space to explore ideas, work on challenging projects, and collaborate with more than 1,000 driven and like-minded colleagues. 
Development opportunities. You take the lead in your personal and professional growth within Nedap. 

All terms of employment

Required Skills

You enjoy making complex product challenges manageable and helping teams move forward. You switch between conversations about technical details and decisions about the broader product direction. When not everything is clear, you ask questions, make decisions and keep everyone focused on what needs to be delivered.

You also bring:

Product experience: you have at least five years of experience as a Product Owner or Product Manager of a software product, including setting priorities and translating product goals into plans. You have held responsibility for multiple teams, products or topics. 
Product delivery: you have experience guiding development teams from plans to working results. You make progress and risks visible and adjust priorities when needed. 
Technical understanding: you understand how software development works and can discuss technical choices, dependencies and feasibility with engineers and technical leads. 
Stakeholder management: you have experience bringing different interests together and working with large customers or stakeholders in an enterprise environment. You use data and insights to support your decisions. 
Language skills: you have a good command of English, both spoken and written. Dutch is an advantage. 
Leadership experience is an advantage: this includes experience managing and developing people. Experience with software that interacts with hardware is also an advantage. 

Good to know: you are available for 32 to 38 hours per week. Hybrid working is the norm at Nedap, and you and your team can coordinate your working hours to support a good work-life balance. You will spend two to three days a week at our campus in Groenlo.

Beyond your experience, it is important to us that you identify with our culture and values and are eager to contribute to our purpose of creating Technology for Life.

Get in touch!

Hi, I’m Marten Adolfsen, Recruitment Business Partner. Are you excited about this opportunity? I’d love to hear from you. Apply now by sending us your CV and/or motivation via the application button. If you have any questions, feel free to contact me at marten.adolfsen@nedap.com.

AI in your work

At Nedap, we see AI as a valuable tool to help us work smarter. We are curious about what it makes possible and actively explore how it can help us collaborate better, improve the way we work, and create solutions that truly matter. We expect you to do the same: remain curious, explore how AI can add value in your work, and use it thoughtfully, responsibly, and with sound judgment. We provide the tools, space, and support to do so.

About Nedap

Nedap is a global leader in Digital Twin Technology, bridging the physical and digital worlds in Retail, Healthcare, Livestock, and Security. Guided by our Technology for Life philosophy, we create smart, sustainable solutions that help people and organizations thrive in a rapidly changing world. With over 1,000 colleagues, we shape the future with meaningful innovations.
